name: anypair-web
description: Anypair site: static pages + a browser bundle that reads Base and sends transactions through the wallet

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/chain.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=site/js/chain.js && esbuild src/chain.js --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outfile=site/server/chain.cjs && esbuild src/wallet.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=site/js/wallet.js
scripts.build:fork: npm run bundle && python3 build.py fork
scripts.build:live: npm run bundle && python3 build.py live
